label: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE (Fixture Co): counterexample: passing autograder tests and AI-generated code used as the only evidence of understanding.

objectives.text: Explain how a loop totals weekly revenue by tracing the running total.

tasks.prompt: Submit code that passes the three autograder tests.

rubric.scoring_rationale: Full credit when all tests pass.

levels.descriptor: Beginning: values typed in, or calculation wrong
Developing: correct method on some items, one error in references or logic
Proficient: correct results from cell references or queries, with a one-sentence explanation
Advanced: proficient, and the model updates correctly when an input changes, with the reason stated
